short_description:
Every main 3D-era GTA ranked by its Metacritic critic score (PlayStation versions): GTA 6 99 (tied with Ocarina of Time for the highest ever), GTA IV 98, GTA III 97, GTA V 97, Vice City 95, San Andreas 95. S tier = 98+, A = 97, B = 95. Which one is ranked too low?

Sources: Metacritic, VGC, Notebookcheck, Insider Gaming, Sportskeeda.
